scope.zh: 谁在买、为何买、怎么付钱：十二个买家／云运营商的资本开支、财报问答或服务模式，加四个跨公司主题。2026-10-18复核C02–C04；金额均为美元。先区分自然年/财年、现金购置/融资租赁新增资产/租赁本金及多年承诺，再作比较；本页不汇总为统一的AI资本开支总额。客户集中度未纳入。 本轮2026-11-12仅对选定条目补证或更新；其余内容保留历史日期，完整覆盖尚未完成。 新增Nebius、Lambda、Fluidstack为服务模式核查，不是财报覆盖扩容；云运营商既供应租赁算力也汇聚上游采购，客户支出与运营商投入不可重复加总。
scope.en: Who buys, why, and how they pay: capex, Q&A or service models for twelve buyers/cloud operators plus four themes. C02–C04 reviewed 2026-10-18; amounts in USD. Distinguish calendar/fiscal years, cash purchases, finance-lease additions, lease principal and multi-year commitments before comparing. No normalized AI-capex total or customer-concentration dataset is provided. The 12 November 2026 review updates selected entries only; other content retains historical dates and complete coverage remains pending. Nebius, Lambda and Fluidstack additions cover service models, not expanded earnings coverage; cloud operators supply rental compute and aggregate upstream procurement, so tenant spend and provider investment must not be double-counted.

primary-read.zh: 已打开并阅读官方原文。
primary-read.en: Official primary document opened and read.

primary-located.zh: 已定位官方来源，细节取自搜索摘要，未逐字核对。
primary-located.en: Official source located; details come from search summaries, not checked verbatim.

secondary-authoritative.zh: 权威机构或行业组织的二手转述。
secondary-authoritative.en: Relayed by an authoritative body or trade press.

secondary.zh: 媒体或聚合站摘要，数字可能因口径或时点不同而冲突。
secondary.en: Press or aggregator summary; figures may conflict by scope or timing.

editorial.zh: 本站对财报问答与来源的编辑归纳，不是已核实结论。
editorial.en: This site’s editorial synthesis of Q&A and sources; not a verified conclusion.

title.zh: Meta：2026年资本开支指引收窄至$135–145B

summary.zh: Q3公告将全年资本开支（含融资租赁本金）下限由$130B提高至$135B，上限保持$145B。该金额是公司全年指引，不是已交付AI算力或纯GPU采购额。
summary.en: The Q3 release raises the lower end of full-year capex including finance-lease principal from $130B to $135B, keeping $145B at the top. It is company guidance, not delivered AI capacity or GPU-only purchases.

facts.zh: Q2资本开支（含融资租赁本金）$31.08B；经营现金流$31.86B；自由现金流$0.784B。
facts.en: Q2 capex including finance-lease principal $31.08B; operating cash flow $31.86B; free cash flow $0.784B.
Q2 narrowed the range from $125–145B to $130–145B; Q3 narrowed it further to $135–145B.

facts.zh: Q3资本开支$34.91B、经营现金流$32.79B、自由现金流−$2.12B；上方Q2金额保留为历史比较。
facts.en: Q3 capex $34.91B, operating cash flow $32.79B and free cash flow −$2.12B; Q2 figures above remain historical comparisons.

sources.label: Meta Q2 2026 results (press release PDF)
Meta Q3 2026 release — capex and CFO outlook
sources.reading_scope: Selected relevant body sections; not full underlying specification or contract

caveat.zh: 本轮已读Q3公告相关正文；旧Q2问答链接保留且不代表Q3证词。未据总资本开支推断芯片供应商份额或已通电容量。
caveat.en: Relevant Q3 release text read this run. Retained Q2 Q&A links are not Q3 testimony. Total capex does not establish chip-vendor share or energised capacity.

title.zh: Alphabet：2026自然年资本开支 $195–205B，已核对官方原文
title.en: Alphabet: CY2026 capex $195–205B, primary text verified

summary.zh: 7月22日官方电话会中，CFO将2026自然年全公司资本开支指引由$180–190B上调至$195–205B，主要因产能交付加快。该金额不是Google Cloud或AI专属预算。
summary.en: On July 22, the CFO raised company-wide CY2026 capex guidance from $180–190B to $195–205B, primarily because capacity delivery accelerated. This is not a Google Cloud or AI-only budget.

facts.zh: Q2（截至6月30日三个月）现金购置PP&E为$44.924B；经营现金流$39.069B，减去PP&E购置后自由现金流为−$5.855B。来源：业绩公告第7、9页。
facts.en: Q2 (three months ended June 30): cash PP&E purchases $44.924B; operating cash flow $39.069B; subtracting PP&E gives FCF −$5.855B. Release pp. 7, 9.

facts.zh: 融资租赁另列：Q2本金现金支付$0.318B、新取得融资租赁资产$0.691B，另有尚未开始租赁的预付款$0.201B；资产新增额与还款不是同一指标。来源：10-Q注4及脚注。
facts.en: Finance leases are separate: Q2 principal cash payments $0.318B, new finance-lease assets $0.691B, plus $0.201B of prepayments for uncommenced leases. Additions and repayments are different measures. 10-Q Note 4 and footnote.

facts.zh: 6月30日尚未开始的租赁未来付款$85.2B；采购承诺及其他合同义务$811.0B涉及多年基础设施、库存、内容及能源，并非2026年现金资本开支。来源：10-Q注4及MD&A。
facts.en: At June 30, uncommenced leases carried $85.2B of future payments; $811.0B of purchase/other contractual obligations spans infrastructure, inventory, content and energy over multiple years, not CY2026 cash capex. 10-Q Note 4 and MD&A.

facts.zh: 2027年资本开支预计显著增加，但本次官方电话会未给出金额。
facts.en: Management expects a significant capex increase in 2027 but gave no amount on this call.

sources.label: Alphabet Q2 2026 official transcript — CFO, pp. 11–13
Alphabet Q2 2026 release — cash flow p. 7; FCF p. 9
Alphabet June 2026 10-Q — Note 4; MD&A capital expenditures and commitments

caveat.zh: 本次核对覆盖上述支出与会计事实；所链接的站内问答不因此自动升级。季度资本开支对应现金PP&E口径；官方材料未提供全年含各类租赁及承诺的统一预测。本页不将多年承诺与年度指引相加，也不据金额推算GPU数量或实际算力。
caveat.en: Verification covers the spending/accounting facts above, not an automatic upgrade of linked site Q&A. Quarterly capex maps to cash PP&E; no full-year all-in lease/commitment forecast is reconciled here. Do not add multi-year obligations to annual guidance or infer GPU counts or delivered compute from dollars.

title.zh: Microsoft：2026自然年约$175B，会计重分类不等于削减投入
title.en: Microsoft: CY2026 ~$175B; lease reclassification does not mean an investment cut

summary.zh: 4月官方指引为2026自然年约$190B；7月29日调整至约$175B，反映更多未来数据中心租赁由融资租赁转为经营租赁。管理层明确表示基础投资计划不变；这两个数不是相同口径下的支出削减。
summary.en: April guidance was ~$190B for CY2026; July 29 guidance became ~$175B as more future datacenter leases shift from finance to operating classification. Management said underlying investment expectations were unchanged; these figures do not measure a like-for-like spending cut.

facts.zh: 从FY27开始（2026年7月1日），数据中心及办公楼预计使用年限由15年延至25年；不是CPU/GPU折旧年限。经营租赁不计入公司资本开支，融资租赁计入；不能称所有新租赁都转为经营租赁。
facts.en: From FY27 (July 1, 2026), datacenter/office-building useful lives extend from 15 to 25 years, not CPU/GPU lives. Reported capex includes finance leases and excludes operating leases; management did not say all new leases would change classification.

facts.zh: FY26 Q4（2026年4–6月）：报告资本开支约$41B，电话会另披露融资租赁$5.6B；公告现金PP&E购置$35.802B。这不是可直接相加的现金支出表，现金支付时点与资产新增口径不同。
facts.en: FY26 Q4 (April–June 2026): reported capex ~$41B; the call separately disclosed $5.6B of finance leases, while release cash PP&E purchases were $35.802B. These are not an additive cash-spending table; payment timing differs from asset additions.

facts.zh: FY26全年（截至2026年6月30日）现金PP&E购置$115.948B，不是自然年$175B指引。4月的$190B指引包含约$25B组件涨价影响，不能全部视作产能增长。
facts.en: FY26 cash PP&E purchases were $115.948B for the year ended June 30, 2026, distinct from the CY2026 ~$175B outlook. April’s ~$190B outlook included ~$25B of component-price effects, not solely capacity growth.

facts.zh: FY27（2026年7月–2027年6月）只给出资本开支同比增长方向；FY27 Q1为超过$50B（含重分类影响），不是FY27全年$175B。
facts.en: FY27 (July 2026–June 2027) guidance is for capex growth without a full-year amount; FY27 Q1 is over $50B including reclassification. ~$175B is not FY27 guidance.

sources.label: Microsoft FY26 Q4 official transcript — Amy Hood capex and useful-life/outlook remarks
Microsoft FY26 Q3 official transcript — CY2026 guidance and finance-lease timing
Microsoft FY26 Q4 release — cash-flow statement, quarter/year ended June 30

caveat.zh: 融资租赁在开始时确认全额，不等于当期支付的本金；折旧变化本身也不是现金节约。已核对电话会及现金流公告，但未取得可读的FY26 10-K来建立完整租赁/承诺桥接；保留约$41B、$5.6B与$35.802B的原始披露，不强行配平。站内关联问答仍沿用原证据。
caveat.en: Finance leases are recognized at commencement, not as current principal payments; depreciation changes are not cash savings. Calls and the release were read, but a readable FY26 10-K was not obtained for a full lease/commitment bridge. Retain ~$41B, $5.6B and $35.802B as disclosed without forcing reconciliation. Linked Q&A keeps its original provenance.

title.zh: Amazon：现金资本开支已核对，2026年约$220B仍待原始来源确认
title.en: Amazon: cash-capex basis verified; CY2026 ~$220B still needs primary confirmation

summary.zh: 官方10-Q确认Q2现金资本开支$53.1B、上半年$96.3B。第三方电话会转录称2026自然年现金资本开支预期由约$200B升至$220B；本次未核对官方录音中的该句，全年数保留secondary，不作为已获一手验证的预算。
summary.en: The official 10-Q confirms Q2 cash capex of $53.1B and H1 $96.3B. A third-party call transcript reports CY2026 cash-capex expectations rising from ~$200B to ~$220B. The official audio statement was not verified in this review; the annual outlook remains secondary.

facts.zh: 已读一手：Q2现金PP&E购置$54.208B，减出售款及激励$1.132B，净现金资本开支=$53.076B（四舍五入$53.1B）；上半年对应$98.411B−$2.101B=$96.310B。来源：Q2公告现金流表及10-Q MD&A。
facts.en: Primary-read: Q2 gross cash PP&E $54.208B less sales/incentives $1.132B = net cash capex $53.076B (~$53.1B); H1 $98.411B − $2.101B = $96.310B. Q2 release cash flows and 10-Q MD&A.

facts.zh: 已读一手：Q2融资租赁本金支付$0.395B、新取得融资租赁PP&E $0.563B单独披露；经营租赁现金支付及尚未支付的资产也不等于现金PP&E。公司范围包括AWS和履约网络，并非纯AI/GPU投资。
facts.en: Primary-read: Q2 finance-lease principal $0.395B and new finance-lease PP&E $0.563B are separate. Operating-lease cash payments and unpaid asset additions are not cash PP&E either. Company-wide scope includes AWS and fulfillment, not exclusively AI/GPUs.

facts.zh: 已读一手历史指引：2月5日公告预计2026年全公司资本开支约$200B；这不是7月更新后已核实的最新金额。全年约$220B及内存涨价归因仅见所列第三方转录。
facts.en: Primary-read historical guidance: the February 5 release projected ~$200B of company-wide 2026 capex. This is not a verified latest post-July figure. The ~$220B update and memory-price attribution rely on the listed third-party transcript.

facts.zh: 多年承诺：6月30日尚未开始的租赁$137.214B、无条件采购义务$130.065B单独列报，包含非基础设施项目；不是2026年已花出的现金，不能与全年资本开支相加。来源：10-Q注4。
facts.en: Multi-year commitments: $137.214B of uncommenced leases and $130.065B of unconditional purchase obligations at June 30 include non-infrastructure items. They are not cash spent in 2026 and must not be added to annual capex. 10-Q Note 4.

sources.label: Amazon Q2 2026 release — cash-flow statement (primary-read actuals)
Amazon June 2026 10-Q — Notes 1, 4; MD&A liquidity (primary-read)
Amazon Q4 2025 release, February 5, 2026 — historical ~$200B outlook
Motley Fool Q2 2026 call transcript — Andy Jassy cash-capex update (not company-published)

caveat.zh: 本条secondary针对最新全年指引；标为“已读一手”的历史金额及定义已核对官方公告/10-Q。Q2公告与10-Q未提供$220B预测，官方录音未听取；不据第三方转录升级。积压、Trainium及NVIDIA的关联问答仍为原有编辑归纳；本次未审核其客户采用结论或分配给自研芯片的预算。
caveat.en: The secondary badge applies to the latest annual outlook; explicitly marked actuals/definitions were checked in company releases and the 10-Q. Neither Q2 document supplies the $220B forecast; official audio was not listened to. Linked backlog/Trainium/NVIDIA Q&A remains editorial; adoption conclusions and custom-silicon budget allocations were not audited here.

title.zh: Oracle：自有资本开支与合作方/客户资本分开
title.en: Oracle: Oracle-funded capex separated from partner and customer capital

summary.zh: 问答显示 Oracle 区分硬件自有与供应商租赁模式，长期合同用固定价格或成本传导条款抵御组件涨价，并拒绝给出现金流转正的具体日期。
summary.en: The Q&A shows Oracle distinguishing owned hardware from supplier-rental models, protecting long-term contracts with fixed prices or pass-through clauses against component inflation, and declining a specific cash-flow date.

caveat.zh: 只依据站内财报问答；Stargate 站点进度见能源页。
caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A; Stargate site progress is on the energy page.

title.zh: CoreWeave：延误来自带电厂房交付，而非电力可得性
title.en: CoreWeave: delays came from powered-shell delivery, not power availability

summary.zh: 管理层称基础设施交付延误由带电厂房（powered shell）交付造成，并强调多供应商分散、客户主导的 NVIDIA 需求，未承诺定制 ASIC 路线。
summary.en: Management attributed delivery delays to powered-shell delivery rather than power availability and emphasised provider diversification and customer-led NVIDIA demand without committing to a custom-ASIC roadmap.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 阿里巴巴：稀缺算力优先分配给高价值模型与推理服务
title.en: Alibaba: scarce compute goes to higher-value model and inference services first

summary.zh: 管理层称企业客户的付费意愿更清晰，所以基础设施目前主要服务企业；对简单GPU出租让位于高价值模型与推理服务；支出受交付时点、CPU需求和组件涨价影响。
summary.en: Management said enterprise customers show clearer willingness to pay, so most infrastructure supports business customers; simple GPU rental yields to higher-value model and inference services; spending was driven by delivery timing, CPU demand and component inflation.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 腾讯：支出下降归因于芯片可得性，而非需求预期下降
title.en: Tencent: lower spending attributed to chip availability, not lower token-demand expectations

summary.zh: 管理层称瓶颈在中国的加速器受限，CPU与网络通过既有关系保障；预计设备端与云端混合推理逐步迁移。
summary.en: Management said China’s accelerator supply is the constraint, with CPU and networking secured through established relationships, and expected a gradual hybrid device/cloud inference shift.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 百度：资产减值、融资选择与GPU云毛利
title.en: Baidu: asset impairment, funding choices and GPU-cloud margin

summary.zh: 管理层称部分旧资产不再满足效率需求并更新组合；融资可用租赁或借款；提升GPU云毛利靠产品组合、自研芯片、利用率与规模。
summary.en: Management said some older assets no longer met efficiency needs and refreshed the portfolio; funding may use leasing or borrowing; GPU-cloud margins depend on mix, proprietary chips, utilisation and scale.

caveat.en: Based only on the site’s Q&A.

title.zh: 主题：积压、合同型与按需需求
title.en: Theme: backlog, contract versus on-demand demand

summary.zh: 买家把已知积压放进产能计划，Oracle 用固定价格或传导条款保护长期合同——需求信号越来越多来自合同而非即时用量。
summary.en: Buyers fold known backlog into capacity plans and Oracle protects long-term contracts with fixed prices or pass-through clauses — demand signals increasingly come from contracts rather than spot use.

caveat.zh: 编辑归纳，样本为公司各自的少量问答。
caveat.en: Editorial synthesis from a handful of Q&As per company.

title.zh: 主题：融资、租赁与多年承诺
title.en: Theme: financing, leases and multi-year commitments

summary.zh: Meta的资本开支含融资租赁本金；Microsoft口径含融资租赁新增资产但排除经营租赁；Alphabet现金PP&E及Amazon净现金PP&E也不能直接混用。承诺是未来义务存量，不是年度支出；经营租赁也不应一概称为表外融资。
summary.en: Meta includes finance-lease principal; Microsoft includes finance-lease additions but excludes operating leases from capex. Alphabet cash PP&E and Amazon net cash PP&E also differ. Commitments are future-obligation balances, not annual spending; operating leases should not be labelled universally off-balance-sheet.

sources.label: Alphabet June 2026 10-Q — leases and commitments
Microsoft FY26 Q4 official transcript — lease classification
Amazon June 2026 10-Q — leases, commitments and cash capex

caveat.zh: 编辑比较，依据C01–C04；不是统一会计口径的排名或总额。多年采购/租赁承诺可能与未来年度资本开支重叠，未经期间及重复项核对不得相加。
caveat.en: Editorial comparison based on C01–C04, not a normalized ranking or total. Multi-year purchase/lease commitments may overlap future annual capex; reconcile periods and overlap before adding anything.

title.zh: 主题：定制芯片是需求的分流还是补充
title.en: Theme: custom silicon as demand diversion or complement

summary.zh: Amazon 称 Trainium 仍需交付量与软件改善且继续购买 NVIDIA；Microsoft 保留外部供应商以保持成本弹性；CoreWeave 强调客户主导的 NVIDIA 需求。
summary.en: Amazon says Trainium needs volume and software progress while NVIDIA purchases continue; Microsoft keeps external suppliers for cost flexibility; CoreWeave stresses customer-led NVIDIA demand.

title.zh: 主题：组件涨价进入资本开支
title.en: Theme: component inflation flowing into capex

summary.zh: Microsoft 4月官方2026自然年指引包含约$25B组件涨价；7月数字的下降另有租赁重分类因素。Alphabet称上调主要因产能交付加快；Amazon约$220B指引及内存涨价解释尚属二手。金额增长不能直接换算为算力增长。
summary.en: Microsoft’s April CY2026 outlook included ~$25B of component-price effects; its July reduction also reflects lease reclassification. Alphabet attributed its raise mainly to faster capacity delivery. Amazon’s ~$220B outlook and memory-cost explanation remain secondary. Spending growth cannot be read directly as compute growth.

sources.label: Microsoft FY26 Q3 official transcript — ~$25B price effect
Alphabet Q2 2026 official transcript — capacity delivery, p. 13
Amazon Q2 2026 third-party transcript — memory-cost attribution

caveat.zh: 跨公司含义为编辑归纳；Microsoft与Alphabet所述原因已读一手，Amazon仍待官方原文确认。没有统一的价格/数量/设备组合分解。
caveat.en: Cross-company implications remain editorial; the Microsoft and Alphabet explanations were read in primary text, while Amazon awaits primary confirmation. There is no common price/volume/equipment-mix decomposition.

title.zh: Nebius：按需实例与预留容量分开看
title.en: Nebius: distinguish on-demand instances from reserved capacity

summary.zh: 官方产品页提供按需及可抢占虚拟机，并支持多节点集群；自助服务说明无需长期预先承诺。预留容量及价格另向销售询问。
summary.en: Official product pages describe on-demand and preemptible VMs and multi-node clusters. Self-service avoids long-term upfront commitments; reserved capacity and pricing are separate sales discussions.

facts.zh: 官方说明托管Kubernetes及Slurm编排。服务菜单表示提供方式，不证明任一区域即时库存、GPU利用率或最终客户已消耗算力。
facts.en: Managed Kubernetes and Slurm are described. A service menu establishes the offering, not live inventory in every region, utilization or end-customer compute consumption.

sources.label: Nebius Compute — cloud flexibility and getting started
sources.reading_scope: Selected substantive sections; publication date not supplied; current observation, not a dated new announcement

sources.label: Nebius Self-service — commitments and orchestration
sources.locator: Flexibility without commitments; Orchestration made easy
sources.reading_scope: Selected substantive sections; publication date not supplied; current observation, not a dated new announcement

caveat.zh: 本条是2026-11-12读取的服务范围观察，页面未注明发布日期；未核查合同、实时配额或交付。编辑关注：按需用量与预留承诺分开，不能把运营商扩张预算与租户支出重复计为需求。
caveat.en: Service-scope observation read on 12 November 2026; publication dates are unspecified. Contracts, live quotas and delivery were not verified. Editorial focus: separate usage from reservations and avoid counting provider expansion and tenant spending twice.

title.zh: Lambda：按需VM、集群预留与专用云
title.en: Lambda: on-demand VMs, cluster reservations and private cloud

summary.zh: On-Demand Cloud提供GPU虚拟机；1-Click Clusters需选择期限、区域并申请预留；Private Cloud为按约定期间预留的裸机单租户集群。不同服务不能视为同一种现货需求。
summary.en: On-Demand Cloud offers GPU VMs; 1-Click Clusters require duration, region and a reservation request. Private Cloud offers bare-metal single-tenant clusters for defined periods. These are distinct demand and commitment models.

facts.zh: ODC文档明确并非每种实例在每个区域都可用；1CC流程区分申请、批准付款与开始日启动，申请不等于已交付。
facts.en: ODC documentation warns that not every instance type is available in every region. The 1CC workflow separates request, approval/payment and launch on the start date; a request is not delivery.

title.zh: Fluidstack：裸机托管编排与交付边界
title.en: Fluidstack: managed bare-metal orchestration and delivery boundaries

summary.zh: 官方文档描述面向训练和推理的裸机托管Kubernetes，以及面向训练的托管Slurm；此处收录的是服务机制，不是已核实的采购量或客户合同。
summary.en: Official documentation describes managed bare-metal Kubernetes for training and inference and managed Slurm for training. This entry records service mechanisms, not verified procurement volume or customer contracts.

facts.zh: 文档列出主动/被动健康检查及集群可观测性；Slurm还列出拓扑感知调度。这些是厂商功能描述，不是独立验证的可靠性或性能结果。
facts.en: Documentation lists active/passive health checks and cluster observability; Slurm also lists topology-aware scheduling. These are vendor feature descriptions, not independently verified reliability or performance results.
